description: Use this skill whenever a user asks about connecting their own AI model to Firefox Smart Window, also called BYOM (bring your own model) or BYO endpoint. Trigger when users ask how to use a custom model, how to connect OpenRouter, how to use Ollama or Lemonade Server with Smart Window, what the "Custom: Use your own LLM" option is, how to enter a model name or API key, or what a model endpoint is. Also trigger for questions like "can I use my own ChatGPT API key?", "how do I run a local model?", "I want to use a free model", or "how do I set up a custom endpoint in Smart Window?" This is a power-user feature — be clear about the caveats upfront.
